rulings.model: The restatement's gate also requires 'Use the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet?' = true, but the IRS says use the Schedule D Tax Worksheet if you have to file Form 4952 and have an amount on line 4g, even if you don't need to file Schedule D.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; the model says the gate wrongly also requires "Use the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet?" because a Form 4952 line 4g filer must use the Schedule D Tax Worksheet "even if you don't need to file Schedule D". The QDCG gate (f1040.gate.qdcg_applies: line 15 more than zero, and qualified dividends, capital gain distributions without Schedule D, or Schedule D lines 15 and 16 gains) is the negation of the Exception that the same page applies to both worksheets: i1040sd p. 15, Schedule D Tax Worksheet, "Exception: Don't use the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet or this worksheet to figure your tax if: • Line 15 or line 16 of Schedule D is zero or less and you have no qualified dividends on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 3a; or • Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 15, is zero or less". A line 4g amount comes from qualified dividends or net capital gain, so such a filer meets the gate. The reading is the one chosen in amb.2025.sd4952_selection ("Use the detailed worksheet conditions, including line 4g and exceptions").

rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding; the model says the line omits the box "If you do not want to claim the ACTC, check here". Form 1040 (2025) p. 2, line 28: "Additional child tax credit (ACTC) from Schedule 8812. If you do not want to claim the ACTC, check here"; i1040gi p. 61, Line 28: "If you do not want to claim the additional child tax credit, check the box on line 28." The project has no line for the box and no question for the election, and unlike line 27c (TASKS.md T-027) no scope or register record covers it: every return claims the ACTC and the box prints unchecked. The project's amount is right for a filer who claims the credit; a filer who elects not to claim gets line 28 = Schedule 8812 line 27 instead of the box checked and no credit. Severity: a printed box on every return, and an amount (line 28, 32, 33, refund) only for a filer who would opt out. Finding F1 in f1040.findings.md.
